3. **Summary of Findings ([stage-report.md](file:///Users/hishamel-husseini/.codex/visualizations/2026/10/21/01a15d64-4430-7440-b259-192acf9762b5/raffle-audit-r001/runtime/gemini-native-repairs/TOB/attempt-04/S3/work/stage-report.md#L562-L742))**:

   - **TIA-02 (Medium)**: Outbound prize delivery in [`redeemWinningTicket`](file:///Users/hishamel-husseini/.codex/visualizations/2026/10/21/01a15d64-4430-7440-b259-192acf9762b5/raffle-audit-r001/runtime/gemini-native-repairs/TOB/attempt-04/S3/work/packages/contracts/src/Raffle.sol#L334-L336) and permissionless [`releaseSponsorPrize`](file:///Users/hishamel-husseini/.codex/visualizations/2026/10/21/01a15d64-4430-7440-b259-192acf9762b5/raffle-audit-r001/runtime/gemini-native-repairs/TOB/attempt-04/S3/work/packages/contracts/src/Raffle.sol#L404-L406) uses raw `IERC721.transferFrom` instead of `safeTransferFrom`, risking stuck NFTs in contract `sponsorRecipient` or contract `winner` addresses that do not handle arbitrary ERC-721 tokens.
   - **TIA-03 (Medium)**: While a USDC-blacklisted ticket holder can transfer their `RAFFLE` ERC-721 ticket to an un-blacklisted address in `CashWon`/`Refunding`, `sponsorRecipient` and `protocolTreasury` are immutable and have no fallback recipient if blacklisted by Circle.
   - **TIA-04 (Medium)**: [`Raffle.buyEntries`](file:///Users/hishamel-husseini/.codex/visualizations/2026/10/21/01a15d64-4430-7440-b259-192acf9762b5/raffle-audit-r001/runtime/gemini-native-repairs/TOB/attempt-04/S3/work/packages/contracts/src/Raffle.sol#L223-L234) credits `unsettledPot += grossAmount` without verifying `balanceAfter - balanceBefore`.
   - **TIA-05 (Low)**: Direct ERC-20 transfers to `Raffle` outside `buyEntries` are unrecoverable, and `i_linkToken` is omitted from [`_isProtocolDestination`](file:///Users/hishamel-husseini/.codex/visualizations/2026/10/21/01a15d64-4430-7440-b259-192acf9762b5/raffle-audit-r001/runtime/gemini-native-repairs/TOB/attempt-04/S3/work/packages/contracts/src/Raffle.sol#L575-L591).
   - **TIA-06 (Low)**: `Raffle.tokenURI(uint256)` returns `""` for all minted tickets and inherits two unused storage slots (`_name`, `_symbol`) from OpenZeppelin `ERC721`.
   - **TIA-07 (Informational)**: Custom lifecycle events in [`IRaffle.sol`](file:///Users/hishamel-husseini/.codex/visualizations/2026/10/21/01a15d64-4430-7440-b259-192acf9762b5/raffle-audit-r001/runtime/gemini-native-repairs/TOB/attempt-04/S3/work/packages/contracts/src/interfaces/IRaffle.sol#L221-L289) and [`IRaffleFactory.sol`](file:///Users/hishamel-husseini/.codex/visualizations/2026/10/21/01a15d64-4430-7440-b259-192acf9762b5/raffle-audit-r001/runtime/gemini-native-repairs/TOB/attempt-04/S3/work/packages/contracts/src/interfaces/IRaffleFactory.sol#L74-L83) lack `indexed` parameters, and `_isProtocolDestination` queries `canonicalFactory.raffleImplementation()` via external `STATICCALL` on every ticket transfer.
